sports.body: Suhas Yathiraj's bronze medal at the Asian Para Games in Nagoya left him disappointed after missing out on a chance to fight for gold. The 43-year-old Indian shuttler, who has won silver medals at the Tokyo and Paris Paralympics, continues to juggle his responsibilities as an IAS officer with the demands of professional badminton. With the Los Angeles 2028 Paralympics on the horizon, he remains determined to go one better and win gold.
